proofs.text: Read the triple, rewrite the rule line with doubled spaces and an added `[origin: pm]` tag, and read it again; verify the two values are equal

rule_text: Reflowing a rule's whitespace or adding a tag leaves the triple where it was, because the triple binds the rule text with its tags stripped

tests.body:
def test_reflowing_a_rule_and_adding_a_tag_keep_the_triple(self, proved):
        before = sign_module.triple_for(proved.rule('RULE-1'))
        proved.spec(SPEC.replace(
            '- RULE-1: Valid credentials return 200 with a session token '
            '[risk: low]',
            '- RULE-1: Valid   credentials  return 200  with a session token '
            '[origin: pm] [risk: low]'))
        after = sign_module.triple_for(proved.rule('RULE-1'))
        assert after == before, (
            'the triple binds the rule text with its tags stripped')
